subject: Renewal uplift: granular seat transfer & annualization build-out
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@novacorp.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Li <jordan.li@novacorp.com>
Date: 2027-12-04T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Mid-contract uplift + seat transfers — pricing ask

Hi Hannah,

We need to firm up pricing for a mid-contract uplift and a cross-BU seat transfer. High level: our sales org needs to add 120 seats to the existing Novacorp annual commitment (currently 600 seats, renewal in Jun 2028). Two asks:

- Can we annualize the 120-seat top-up immediately (i.e., invoice for the remainder of the year prorated then convert to full-year at the next renewal) or do you have a true mid-year annualization path?
- We also need to transfer ~40 seats from BU-1 to BU-3 (same legal entity). Can you apply a credit for unused seats and avoid double billing during the transfer window?

Procurement also asked for a draft amendment and an example Excel showing the seat math and invoice timing (they want this in the PO). Appreciate a clear recommendation and the delta in unit price if we annualize vs. leave as a pro-rata top-up.

Thanks —
Elaine
Elaine Park
Head of Sales Operations, Novacorp
elaine.park@novacorp.com
+1 415-555-0198

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@novacorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-04T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mid-contract uplift + seat transfers — pricing ask

Hi Elaine — thanks for the clear note. Quick summary up front: we can support both flows. I attached a sample workbook (Novacorp_Uplift_Model.xlsx) and a redlineable amendment template to speed the PO. Two practical options:

Option A — Pro-rata top-up (fastest)
- Add 120 seats immediately at current committed unit rate (USD per seat).
- Invoice pro-rated for remainder of current term; no change to renewal date.
- Transfer window: up to 60 days to reassign seats between BUs; any unused seats returned within the window receive a credit equal to the pro-rated value of the unused days.
- No change to renewal pricing or commitments.

Option B — Immediate annualization (preferred for predictability)
- Convert the 120-seat uplift to an annualized add-on effective today. Invoice pro-rated remainder + full-year charge scheduled next invoice as a credit/annualized line so accounting sees the commit.
- Apply a seat-transfer credit for up to 40 seats moved between BUs within a 90-day window; credit is calculated as (remaining days on term / 365) * seat price and applied as a one-time credit on the next invoice.
- As an incentive to annualize mid-term we can offer a 10% uplift discount on those 120 seats (applies only if annualized).

Operational notes / edge cases
- If you annualize and then drop seats before renewal, credits will be processed per the seat-return policy in the amendment (we propose a cap on creditable seats equal to 25% of uplift in the first 180 days).
- We can also offer a blended band price for any usage above the committed seats during the year (helps with burst months).

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm preferred option (A or B).
2) We send amendment-draft-v1.docx with the selected flow and the line-item math populated from the attached workbook.
3) Ben (cc’d) will coordinate PO, invoice schedule, and DocuSign routing.

I've attached the workbook and amendment draft — workbook has three tabs (math, examples, invoice timing). If you want, we can model a 60/40 seat split so procurement can see line-by-line.

If helpful, happy to set a 30-minute call tomorrow to walk procurement and your SRE billing contact through the invoice/credit mechanics.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Manager, Renewals & Expansion | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@novacorp.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-05T08:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mid-contract uplift + seat transfers — pricing ask

Thanks — operational notes from my side to make this painless for procurement: 

- For Option A (pro-rata top-up): we generate an invoice immediately for the pro-rated amount and a subsequent invoice at renewal for the new total. No amendment required if you prefer a simple top-up; we can still provide a PO-friendly invoice line.

- For Option B (annualize): we need a signed amendment. I will:
  * Pre-populate amendment-draft-v1.docx with line items (SKU: RDW-SEAT-ANNUAL, quantity: +120), term dates, and the 10% incentive line.
  * Add explicit language for "seat transfer credit" mechanics (formula + 90-day window).
  * Include billing contact and net-30 payment terms (per your procurement ask).

- DocuSign: we can send after you confirm which option. For procurement timing: if you sign by Dec 15 we can reflect charges on the Dec invoice and aim for provisioning to complete by Jan 10 (provisioning for reserved seats is typically 3–7 business days after countersignature).

- PO notes: please include your HubSpot deal id (DEAL-8342) on the PO and reference the amendment. I’ll ensure the finance team maps credits properly.

I attached the amendment in draft form with placeholders — Hannah, please confirm the credit cap and discount language I outlined.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@novacorp.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Li <jordan.li@novacorp.com>
Date: 2027-12-07T15:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mid-contract uplift + seat transfers — pricing ask

Hi Hannah / Ben — appreciate the quick turnaround and the workbook. Novacorp will go with Option B (Immediate annualization + 10% incentive) and we accept the 90-day transfer window with the seat credit formula you provided. A couple of procurement notes: 

- Procurement requires net-30 and a single amendment for countersignature; please keep the amendment language minimal and include the credit formula exactly as in the workbook so finance can map it.
- We will issue a PO referencing DEAL-8342; expected PO delivery: Dec 16.
- Can you confirm provisioning target Jan 10 and that any prorated credits will appear on the first invoice post-signature?

If that all looks good, please send the DocuSign-ready amendment and I’ll route the PO.

Thanks —
Elaine
Elaine Park
Head of Sales Operations, Novacorp
